document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your daring throw was right on target! You lose 3D10 DEX 
points in exposing yourself to the horror that is Ghatanothoa, 
but the Top is blown to splinters and the roof of the cavern has 
begun to collapse. 
Dazed and semi-paralyzed, you stumble away, into the 
numbing Antarctic cold. Somehow you reach the Dornier and 
safety. Jones may be there to fly you back, or Crawford may 
dispatch a rescue flight if you have no Pilot (Aircraft) skill. 
Your diagnosis is Dementia Antarctica. Ultimately you realize, 
after your release from a New England sanatorium, that it is 
best to say nothing about your trip. It is …THE END, but you 
triumphed where many failed. Congratulations!
(565, 566)
